title: Comparison of a second-generation trabecular bypass (iStent inject) to ab interno trabeculectomy (Trabectome) by exact matching

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: open-angle glaucoma (POAG, pseudoexfoliation, some angle-closure and normal-tension glaucoma; Table 1) at the time of cataract surgery, on topical medication; neovascular/uveitic glaucoma and prior ocular surgery excluded
design: retrospective comparison; 39 iStent inject eyes matched one-to-one to Trabectome eyes (single centre plus Trabectome Study Group database) by exact matching on baseline IOP, number of medications and glaucoma type, nearest-neighbour matching on age

groups.description: Trabectome ab interno trabeculectomy combined with phacoemulsification (Table 2 'T'); matched controls drawn from 3446 Trabectome eyes
iStent inject (two trabecular bypass stents) combined with phacoemulsification (Table 2 'IS2'); 39 of 53 eyes could be matched

series.notes: mean ± SD; per-visit n not reported
mean ± SD; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: unmatched iStent inject eyes (14 of 53) and unmatched Trabectome eyes
exclusions.reason: not tabulated; the matched analysis set is defined by preoperative covariates only
figure only; the same time points are cited from Table 2

notes: Matching used only preoperative variables (baseline IOP, medications, glaucoma type, age), so the analysis set is not outcome-selected.
Tonometer is not stated in the article; method unstated.
Preoperative IOP on topical glaucoma medication (indication: stable IOP with a wish to reduce medications at cataract surgery, or above-target IOP on maximally tolerated topical treatment).
Medication: mean ± SD number of medications (Rx) per visit is tabulated in Table 2 (C5, C6); not extracted.
Group roles: two established angle procedures compared, no arm declared experimental; both role control.
Part of the Trabectome eyes come from the multicentre Trabectome Study Group database.
